Compute per-well summary metrics

Source: R/quantify.R
cr_compute_metrics.Rd

Returns a rich set of per-well summary statistics for a single channel: mean, median, SD, MAD, CV, cell count and percent positive above a threshold. Useful as input for QC dashboards.

Usage

cr_compute_metrics(experiment, channel, positive_threshold = NULL)

Arguments

experiment

A cr_experiment.

channel

Channel name.

positive_threshold

Optional numeric threshold. Cells above it are considered "positive".

Value

A tibble with one row per spatial unit.

Examples

exp <- cr_example_experiment(seed = 1, n_cells_per_well = 30)
cr_compute_metrics(exp, channel = "marker_1")
